scores.label: A
scores.note: option 8 'waned' is the wrong sense for a cost; 'plummeted' sits oddly with 'so much'; 'sunk' and 'slumped' are a bit casual

scores.label: B
scores.note: options 4 'reduced', 8 'slashed', 9 'cut' and 10 'lowered' are transitive verbs that need an agent, so 'the cost has slashed/cut/lowered/reduced' is ungrammatical in place

scores.label: C
scores.note: options 4, 6, 9 and 10 ('fallen sharply/significantly/rapidly/dramatically') clash with the following 'so much', which makes the sentence ungrammatical in place; 'gone down' is casual; list is mostly variants of 'fallen'
